verdict.rationale: Ramp ships built-in AI agents under 'Ramp Intelligence', and these handle defined finance tasks on their own: auto-coding expenses, fraud flagging, approval routing, payment, receipt capture with AI-filled memos, and AI parsing of contracts into intake forms. That lets users hand off these task categories, with human confirmation before money moves. However, the evidence shows fixed-purpose automations rather than a general in-product assistant users can direct to arbitrary tasks. Ramp MCP and the CLI connect external assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, so they are not built-in and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant that accepts ad hoc delegated tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in agents' behavior.
